prompt: 哪一句頻率副詞的位置是正確的？
options: She goes always to the library on Friday.
She always goes to the library on Friday.
She goes to always the library on Friday.
answer: She always goes to the library on Friday.

wrong.She goes always to the library on Friday: 頻率副詞通常放在一般動詞前面，不是動詞後面。
wrong.She goes to always the library on Friday: always 不能插在介系詞 to 和名詞之間。

why: 頻率副詞放在一般動詞前，be 動詞後。
tip: always、usually 放在一般動詞前面。
say: She always goes to the library on Friday.

text: There _____ a lot of water in the bottle.
options: is
are
be
have

wrong.are: water 是不可數名詞，要搭配單數的 is。
wrong.be: There be 的 be 要依主詞變成 is 或 are，不能直接用原形。
wrong.have: There 開頭的存在句要用 is／are，不用 have。

why: water 是不可數名詞，There is 後面接不可數名詞。
tip: 不可數名詞前面，用 There is。
say: There is a lot of water in the bottle.

prompt: 你想告訴外國朋友：「我的游泳速度不夠快，但我會游蛙式。」
options: I can't swim very fast, but I can swim the breaststroke.
I don't can swim very fast, but I can swim the breaststroke.
I can't swimming very fast, but I can swim the breaststroke.
I not can swim very fast, but I can swim the breaststroke.
answer: I can't swim very fast, but I can swim the breaststroke.

wrong.I don't can swim very fast, but I can sw: can 本身是助動詞，否定直接用 can't，不需要 don't。
wrong.I can't swimming very fast, but I can sw: can't 後面接原形動詞 swim，不能用 swimming。
wrong.I not can swim very fast, but I can swim: 否定要寫成 can't 或 cannot，not 不能放在 can 前面。

why: can 的否定是 can't／cannot，後面接原形動詞。
tip: can 後面接原形動詞，否定用 can't。
say: I can't swim very fast, but I can swim the breaststroke.

text: My cousin _____ eats vegetables. He says he doesn't like them at all.
options: never
always
usually
often

wrong.always: 他說完全不喜歡蔬菜，不可能總是吃。
wrong.usually: usually 表示通常會吃，和「完全不喜歡」矛盾。
wrong.often: often 表示經常吃，和「完全不喜歡」矛盾。

why: 完全不喜歡，所以從來不吃，用 never。
tip: never 的意思是「從來不」，頻率是 0%。

prompt: 哪一句存在句的動詞是正確的？
options: There is three cats under the table.
There are three cats under the table.
There have three cats under the table.
answer: There are three cats under the table.

three cats 是複數，要用 There are，不是 is。
「有」在存在句中要用 There is／are，不用 have。

why: three cats 是複數，所以用 There are。
tip: There is 接單數，There are 接複數。
say: There are three cats under the table.

prompt: 同學問你「你多常運動？」你每週運動兩次，怎麼說最合適？
options: I exercise twice a week.
I exercise two time a week.
I exercise twice in week.
I am exercise twice a week.

「兩次」要說 twice，或 two times，time 要加 s。
每週要說 a week，不是 in week。
am 和 exercise 不能並用，習慣的動作只需用一般動詞 exercise。

why: 回答 How often 的問題，可說 twice a week 表示每週兩次。
tip: once、twice a week：每週一次、兩次。

text: There aren't any chairs in the garden.
options: 花園裡沒有任何椅子。
花園裡有很多椅子。
椅子不在花園，在房子裡。
花園裡只有一張椅子。

wrong.花園裡有很多椅子。: aren't any 是否定，意思和有很多相反。
wrong.椅子不在花園，在房子裡。: 句子只說花園裡沒有椅子，並沒有說椅子在哪裡。
wrong.花園裡只有一張椅子。: 只有一張要說 There is only one chair；這句是完全沒有。

why: There aren't any ... 表示「沒有任何……」，後面接複數名詞。
tip: There aren't any + 複數名詞 = 一個也沒有。
say: There aren't any chairs in the garden.
